rubrics.justification: Describes blastocoel expansion, thinning zona, strong ICM and cohesive TE appropriately and notes the stage-label mismatch; minor limitation is some confidence beyond what can be verified from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, endometriosis, smoking, prior failed cycle, ovarian reserve, sperm quality, BMI, and endometrial thickness with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and probability estimate is tied to embryo quality and patient factors; slight overstatement that 3AA is the highest possible score and some speculative weighting of smoking/endometriosis effects.

Mostly aligned on SET and caution about morphology vs euploidy, but claims 3AA is the highest score, broadly recommends PGT-A, and suggests aspirin/heparin or intensified progesterone without strong guideline-based indication.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, smoking cessation, luteal support review, and endometriosis-focused planning; some recommendations are somewhat nonspecific or not universally indicated.
